meta.sampleQuery:
SELECT id, store_platform, published_meta, published_stsp, published_hltb, published_store,
               store_uscore, igdb_score, igdb_uscore, meta_score, meta_uscore, grnk_score, gfq_rating,
               stsp_owners, genres, hltb_single, igdb_single, hltb_complete, igdb_complete,
               gfq_difficulty, price_ru
        FROM games
        WHERE id % 7 = 1
        ORDER BY RAND()
        LIMIT 300
